plugins.description: A useful plugin that identifies any broken links within your project in one click.

currentVersion.name: LinkCheck
currentVersion.releaseNotes:
Overview:

LinkCheck is a useful plugin to validate and make sure that all the links in your project are working with just one click.

How to use it:

  1. Create an element with a link (must be within a frame)

  2. Click the 'check link" button

  3. If there are any links with errors, an error message will be displayed beside it so you'll know what needs to be updated.

Features:

  1. Check all links within your current project

  2. Check if links are fetchable (eg. via /GET, /HEAD requests)

  3. Check if links include HTTP & HTTPS for security

Benefits:

  1. Save time checking all the links in your project 1-by-1.

  2. View all links in a single table for easier management.

  3. Ensure all links are working or proper standards.

plugins.description: Revolutionize your setup workflow in Framer: Generate custom text styles, perfectly scaled and responsive.

currentVersion.name: TypeSystem
currentVersion.releaseNotes:
Added a bunch of new features and changed a few things according to Max' feedback:

  • Added a Reset button

  • Added a Google Font Input that gets added to the text style, too

  • Delete Text styles now only deletes the text styles generated by the plugin, not other ones

  • Scale dropdown options now show the multiplier number

  • If someone chooses the golden ratio scale, there is a message shown to proceed with caution due to the big text size

  • Em/Pixels selector added to the letter spacing field (only there, since px doesn't make sense to generate as a line height same across all generated styles)

  • Stepper control added to all numeric inputs

I also got a few changes for the plugin marketplace page, will add those when the plugin is approved, seems like I can't add this in here.
